EVENT TIMELINE & SCHEDULE

24 continuous hours of architecture, implementation, evaluation rounds, and gourmet culinary fuel across the multiverse.

PHASE 01 DAY 1 // 08:30 – 12:00
01

REALM CHECK-IN & INCEPTION

Campus ingress at Rushikonda. Squads complete Space Stone badge clearance, workstation allocation, and receive the classified Mind Stone problem matrix before the Cosmic Inception inaugural ceremony.

STATUS: CHECK-IN RUSHIKONDA CAMPUS
PHASE 02 DAY 1 // 12:00 – 21:00
02

CORE SPRINT & STAGES 1 & 2

Continuous development sprint fueled by the Infinity Feast lunch and Pym Particles high tea. Squads undergo Stage 1 idea validation (1 PM) and Stage 2 prototype architecture evaluation (5 PM) by senior judges.

REVIEWS: STAGES 1 & 2 EVALUATION PODS
PHASE 03 OVERNIGHT // 21:00 – 07:00

MIDNIGHT BUILD & STAGE 3 MVP

REVIEW: STAGE 3 MVP TOP 6 SHORTLIST

// ETHICAL COVENANT

CODE OF CONDUCT

Failure to adhere will result in immediate disqualification and total erasure from the leaderboards.

01

FRESH CODE ONLY

All code repositories must be initiated during the 24-hour sprint window. Pre-built apps or templates will be detected by git audit scripts.

02

SQUAD INTEGRITY

Teams strictly range between 3 to 4 members. Inter-college and multi-disciplinary teams are heavily encouraged.

03

HARD PS LOCK-IN

Each squad claims exactly 1 problem statement within their chosen Infinity Stone. Domain switching locks once coding begins.

04

VERIFIED PROOF

Every registration requires a valid payment UTR number verified in real-time. Duplicate or fabricated UTRs are rejected automatically.

// KNOWLEDGE VAULT

ABOUT & FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Answers to essential queries regarding team size, entry fees, payment validation, problem statements, and campus logistics.

Teams must consist strictly of 3 or 4 members. The registration fee is ₹349 per member:

  • 3 Members: ₹349 × 3 = ₹1,047 total
  • 4 Members: ₹349 × 4 = ₹1,396 total

This fee covers round-the-clock campus security, high-speed Wi-Fi, official hacker kits, 5 gourmet meals (High Tea, Dinner, Midnight Fuel, Day 2 Breakfast, Lunch), and certificates.

In accordance with hackathon guidelines, problem statements for each of the 6 Infinity Domains will be unlocked 1 to 2 days prior to the hackathon kickoff. Team leaders can log in to their dashboard at any time to view countdowns and select their problem statement once unlocked by organizers.

During registration, pay the exact fee via UPI to infinityhack@okaxis or scan the dynamic QR code. Upload your payment screenshot. Our portal automatically scans the image to identify your 12-digit UTR number and phone number.

Note: Every transaction UTR must be completely unique. However, the same phone number can be used if a college coordinator or faculty mentor is paying on behalf of multiple squads.

Teams undergo 3 milestone reviews with industry judges. To preserve competitive suspense and prevent bias, judges' numerical scores and evaluation rubrics remain strictly confidential and hidden from team leader dashboards. Final rankings are unveiled during the Grand Valedictory Ceremony.
